rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese way to name a group of animals, including a flock of sheep.

example.english: There is a flock of sheep on the grassland.
example.jyutping: cou2 jyun4 soeng6 jau5 jat1 kwan4 min4 joeng4

rows.note: Use this for a religious congregation as a gathered body rather than for its individual members.

example.english: Our church's flock prays together every Sunday.
example.traditional: 我哋教會嘅會眾每個星期日都一齊祈禱。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaau3 wui6 ge3 wui6 zung3 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 jat1 cai4 kei4 dou2

rows.note: Use this when the flock means the individual Christian members under a pastor.

example.english: The pastor chatted with the flock.
example.jyutping: muk6 si1 tung4 gaau3 jau5 king1 gai2
